scope: Actual renderer capture of three completed passing cases (LAB01, LAB02, LAB03) from a separate recording attempt. This is not a full-suite execution video. The attempt was interrupted after later video startup timeouts; the supplied 26/26 acceptance run is a separate recording.
playback: Source clips retained at natural source speed, joined only at case boundaries; no synthetic application frames, narration or audio. Native OS menus/dialogs are outside the renderer capture.
